summary.name: International Typographic Style (Swiss Style); a supplemental design reference, not a directly named style in the source collection.
summary.visualIdentity: Column grid, baseline alignment, repeated spacing, asymmetric composition and generous negative space. Left-aligned sans-serif type with clear size hierarchy, plus grid-aligned photography.
summary.suitableUses: Explicit: posters, identity and typographic statements where grid and type carry everything. Inferred: headline-led explainers and data stories with a few verified figures.
summary.limitations: A restrained palette makes rich color or texture needs a weak fit (inferred). Charts must stay truthful and labeled. Two-color checks do not verify text over images or video.
summary.palette: Black and white with one restrained red accent. Suggested, not approved, tokens: background #FFFFFF, foreground #000000, accent #D32F2F. Background is scene-dependent, so white is illustrative. Checked pairs: 21:1 foreground/background, 4.979:1 accent on white. Gradients are disabled.
summary.motionAndInteraction: Elements travel along layout axes and settle on shared alignment points without changing reading order. Kinetic-headline rule: no springs or overshoot. Optional motion references 007, 012, 013, 015 and 038; choosing none is valid.
summary.audio: No audio is specified or mandated. Inferred: restrained, speech-friendly choices such as sparse music, ambience or silence at reading holds. Music must not compete with narration; no audio assets are supplied.
summary.assetRequirements: No uploads, exact copy or subject are specified. Needs locally loaded sans-serif fonts, optional grid-aligned photography and truthful chart data. Missing assets must be reported, not invented.
summary.combinations: Style-097 suits grid-based charts with red on one series. Style-093 suits kinetic headlines with red on one keyword per scene. Avoid multi-hue palettes, script faces and bouncy per-letter motion.
summary.productionApproach: HyperFrames is the default pipeline, with one paused, seekable GSAP timeline per composition. HTML/CSS Grid and SVG render the visuals; GSAP owns motion. Remotion is fallback only with a recorded reason. chroma-js validates colors.
